Antenatal Care — 4+ Checkup Coverage

Share of registered pregnancies that completed at least 4 antenatal checkups, by district and year.

Select a year to compare districts.

District comparison —

Detail —

# District ANC4+ completed Pregnancies registered ANC4+ coverage rate Change vs previous year

How the rate is calculated

ANC4+ coverage rate = pregnancies that completed 4+ antenatal checkupspregnancies registered × 100
  • Numerator: anc4_completed — pregnancies with 4 or more antenatal checkups in the selected district and year.
  • Denominator: pregnancies_registered — all pregnancies registered in that district and year.
  • Rates are shown as a percentage, rounded to 1 decimal. "Change vs previous year" is the difference from the previous year's rate, in percentage points.
  • Loading example…

Data source

Simple static site — no external libraries. To run: cd into this folder and run python3 -m http.server 8000, then open http://localhost:8000.

import csv

SRC = "/tmp/io-dev-csv-health-cline-kU0nP6/anc4_coverage.csv"
